name: JobSearch public site navigation works across main pages
description: A visitor can navigate through the main public JobSearch pages, use vacancy search filters, open vacancy and company details, and reach the authentication pages without server errors or broken layout.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the JobSearch homepage.
Verify the homepage loads with a polished hero area, visible job search form, company showcase section, popular links section, new vacancies section, and footer.
Enter a profession keyword and a city in the homepage search form.
Submit the homepage search form.
Verify the vacancies page opens and shows the advanced filter form above the vacancy result cards or a clear empty-results message.
Change several vacancy filters such as salary, employment type, workplace format, and sorting.
Submit the vacancy filters form.
Verify the vacancies page remains stable after filtering, with no internal server error and with the filters still visible above the result area.
Open the first available vacancy details page from the vacancy results.
Verify the vacancy details page shows a job title, company context, city, salary or conditions, and an action area appropriate for a visitor.
Use the visible back navigation control to return from the vacancy details page.
Verify the browser returns to the vacancies page or another valid JobSearch page without an error page.
Open the companies directory from the site navigation or homepage company section.
Verify the companies page shows company cards with names, vacancy counts or a clear empty-state, and consistent card layout.
Open the first available company profile from the companies list.
Verify the company profile page shows the company name, logo or placeholder, industry, city, contacts, and company vacancies section.
Open the employer information page from the public navigation or homepage employer call-to-action.
Verify the employer page explains employer actions and provides a clear path to registration or vacancy publication without requiring a logged-in session.
Open the login page.
Verify the login page shows email and password fields, a submit button, and the normal site header/footer layout.
Open the registration page.
Verify the registration page shows full name, email, password, role selection, and that the employer email-code checkbox appears when employer role is selected.
Open the career advice page through a site link.
Verify the career advice page loads as a styled JobSearch page with readable content, no server error, and no broken top navigation.
Open the market statistics page through a site link.
Verify the market statistics page loads as a styled JobSearch page with readable content, no server error, and no broken top navigation.
Open the security page through a site link.
Verify the security page loads as a styled JobSearch page with readable content, no server error, and no broken top navigation.
Scroll to the footer and inspect the contact and social link area.
Verify the footer shows JobSearch branding, support contact, sections for applicants and employers, and social icons for Telegram, VK, and WhatsApp.
